contributions.statement: Gate efficiency rewards on reaching a resolve-rate threshold when RL-training coding agents.
contributions.evidence: Tables 1-3: resolve 37.4 -> 42.2; token saving 39.8% vs GRPO but ~5% vs base model; Qwen only.

reason: An RL training recipe for small Qwen models; nothing for a team using hosted agents, and the token saving is mostly relative to a GRPO baseline that inflates tokens.
